title: INTERSECT — Common Products Ordered
description: Find product IDs that appear in both the Products and Orders tables using INTERSECT.

data.text: Write a query to find ProductIDs that exist in both the `Products` table and the `OrderDetails` table.

data.title: SQL Solution
data.code:
SELECT ProductID FROM Products
INTERSECT
SELECT ProductID FROM OrderDetails
ORDER BY ProductID;

data.title: Explanation
data.text: INTERSECT returns distinct rows that appear in both result sets. It implicitly removes duplicates and sorts the result. INTERSECT ALL (available in SQL Server 2022+) keeps duplicates. Column order and data types must match between the two SELECT statements.
